accepted.s:
Which of the following territories were given to the British by Salabat Jung in 1759?
1. Machilipatnam
2. Nizampatnam
3. Vakal Mannar
4. Part of Kondapalli
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: In 1759, Salabat Jung gave Machilipatnam, Nizampatnam, Vakal Mannar and part of Kondapalli to the British.
accepted.tq: Use a complete-list statement question and verify every item before choosing the code.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Who granted the Northern Circars to the East India Company through a Mughal firman in 1765?
accepted.x: The Mughal firman granting the Circars to the East India Company was issued by Shah Alam II in 1765, though some sources date it to 1766.
accepted.tq: Identify the issuing authority directly, while distinguishing it from the later Nizam agreement.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the transfer of the Northern Circars is correct?
o: Nizam Ali initially refused to accept the Mughal firman but agreed to lease the Circars in 1766.
The Nizam transferred the Circars only after the Battle of Padmanabham.
The Circars were leased by Salabat Jung in 1768 after the Treaty of Masulipatnam.
Nizam Ali accepted the Mughal firman immediately in 1765.
accepted.x: Nizam Ali initially refused to accept Shah Alam II's firman and agreed to lease the Circars in 1766.
accepted.tq: Separate the Mughal grant of 1765 from the Nizam's acceptance and lease arrangement of 1766.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Treaty of Masulipatnam, which confirmed the arrangement concerning the Northern Circars, was concluded in:
accepted.x: The Treaty of Masulipatnam of 1768 confirmed the arrangement relating to the Northern Circars.
accepted.tq: Match the treaty with its year by separating it from the earlier grant and lease negotiations.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following events:
A. Treaty of Masulipatnam confirmed the arrangement
B. Salabat Jung gave Machilipatnam and other territories to the British
C. Nizam Ali agreed to lease the Circars
D. Guntur was handed over after the death of Basalat Jung
Which one of the following is the correct chronological order?
accepted.x: The correct sequence is 1759, 1766, 1768 and 1788: B, C, A, D.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest territorial grant first and then arrange the lease, confirmation and Guntur transfer.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Who signed the 1766 treaty relating to the lease of the Northern Circars on behalf of the East India Company?
accepted.x: The Company's envoy Calliaud signed the treaty in 1766 by which Nizam Ali agreed to lease the Circars.
accepted.tq: Use the person–deed trap by distinguishing the treaty signatory from other British officials.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Kandregula Jogipantulu was associated with the Northern Circars as a:
accepted.x: Kandregula, also written Kondregula, Jogipantulu was a dubashi who acted as an interpreter and negotiator in the Circars arrangements.
accepted.tq: Discriminate the local mediator's role from military and administrative offices.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about Kandregula Jogipantulu are correct?
1. He was respected by Diwan Ruknudaula.
2. He used the pay mutiny at Gollapudi to propose a lease.
3. He proposed a lease at ₹15 lakh per year.
4. The final treaty fixed the annual amount at ₹9 lakh.
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Jogipantulu was respected by Ruknudaula, used the Gollapudi pay mutiny in negotiations, proposed ₹15 lakh annually, and the final treaty fixed ₹9 lakh.
accepted.tq: Check the sequence from negotiating context to proposed amount and final settled amount.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which title was conferred on Kandregula Jogipantulu by the British?
accepted.x: The British conferred the title Raja Bahadur on Kandregula Jogipantulu. Nizam Ali made him Majumdar of Rajamahendravaram.
accepted.tq: Separate the British honorary title from the office granted by the Nizam.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Nizam Ali appointed Kandregula Jogipantulu as Majumdar of:
accepted.x: Nizam Ali made Jogipantulu the Majumdar of Rajamahendravaram, while the British gave him the title Raja Bahadur.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a territorial office from the honorary title associated with the same person.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following was NOT one of the Circars handed over in 1766?
accepted.x: Mustafanagar, Eluru, Rajamahendravaram and Srikakulam were among the Circars handed over in 1766. Kurnool formed part of the Ceded Districts transferred in 1800.
accepted.tq: Find the item belonging to the later Ceded Districts transfer rather than the 1766 Circars.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Mustafanagar, one of the Circars handed over in 1766, was also known as:
accepted.x: Mustafanagar was the name associated with Kondapalli. Kondaveedu, also called Murtazanagar, was the fifth Circar, Guntur.
accepted.tq: Separate closely related alternative names by linking each name to its corresponding Circar.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following districts are included among the coastal districts covered by the Northern Circars arrangement?
1. Srikakulam
2. Vizianagaram
3. Visakhapatnam
4. East and West Godavari
5. Krishna
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: The coastal districts covered are Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Visakhapatnam, East Godavari, West Godavari and Krishna.
accepted.tq: Use the complete geographical list and check whether any coastal district has been omitted.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which Circar became the principal area of conflict between Nizam Ali and the British?
accepted.x: Guntur Circar was the area of conflict because it was held by Nizam Ali's brother, Basalat Jung. It was the fifth Circar and was also called Kondaveedu or Murtazanagar.
accepted.tq: Apply the specific conflict clue instead of choosing the broader regional term Northern Circars.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Guntur was handed over to the British in 1788 after the death of Basalat Jung and approximately how many years of talks?
accepted.x: Guntur was handed over in 1788 after Basalat Jung's death in 1782 and six years of negotiations. One account records the payment as Rs 7 lakh on 18 September 1788.
accepted.tq: Link the transfer year with the duration of negotiations and the preceding death year.
accepted.sec: Northern Circars - grants, lease talks, Andhra negotiator, Guntur  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following titles are associated with Mir Qamar-ud-din Khan?
1. Chin Qilich Khan
2. Nizam-ul-Mulk
3. Asaf Jah I
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: Mir Qamar-ud-din Khan was known as Chin Qilich Khan, held the title Nizam-ul-Mulk and assumed the title Asaf Jah I.
accepted.tq: Combine alternative names and titles of one historical personality without confusing them with offices of later rulers.
accepted.sec: Asaf Jahi founder - name, title, independence  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Mir Qamar-ud-din Khan became effectively independent in 1724 after defeating Mubariz Khan at:
accepted.x: Mir Qamar-ud-din Khan established effective independence in 1724 after defeating Mubariz Khan at Shakar Kheda.
accepted.tq: Match the independence event with its battlefield rather than with a better-known British battle.
accepted.sec: Asaf Jahi founder - name, title, independence  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following territories formed part of the Ceded Districts transferred by the Nizam to meet the cost of the subsidiary force?
1. Kadapa
2. Kurnool
3. Anantapur
4. Bellary
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: The Ceded Districts included Kadapa, Kurnool, Anantapur and Bellary. They were ceded under the arrangements of 1798 and 1800 in lieu of the subsidy for the subsidiary force.
accepted.tq: Use the territorial list and distinguish the Ceded Districts from the Northern Circars.
accepted.sec: Ceded Districts - territories and treaty

accepted.s: The Nizam's cession of the territories gained from Mysore in 1792 and 1799 was connected with the treaties of:
accepted.x: The Treaty of Hyderabad of 1798 was followed by the treaty of 1800, under which the Nizam ceded territories to meet the cost of the subsidiary force.
accepted.tq: Pair the cession with the two treaty years instead of the earlier Circars agreements.
accepted.sec: Ceded Districts - territories and treaty

accepted.s: The territories ceded by the Nizam to the British came to be known as:
accepted.x: The ceded territories of Kadapa, Kurnool, Anantapur and Bellary were known as Dattamandalalu, or the Ceded Districts.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the regional label for the ceded inland districts from the coastal Northern Circars.
accepted.sec: Ceded Districts - territories and treaty

accepted.s: The proposal to rename Dattamandalalu as Rayalaseema was approved at the Andhra Mahasabha held at Nandyal under the presidency of:
accepted.x: The Andhra Mahasabha at Nandyal, presided over by Dr S. Radhakrishnan, approved the name Rayalaseema proposed by Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao.
accepted.tq: Use the role distinction between the proposer and the presiding authority.
accepted.sec: Ceded Districts - territories and treaty

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about the territorial integration of Andhra under the Company is correct?
1. Nellore and Chittoor were annexed from the Carnatic Nawab in 1801.
2. By 1801, the whole Andhra region was under the Company.
3. Wellesley merged the region into the Madras Presidency.
4. Tamil leaders dominated the Madras Presidency in this arrangement.
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The 1801 acquisition of Nellore and Chittoor completed Company control over the Andhra region, which Wellesley merged into the Madras Presidency.
accepted.tq: Trace the final territorial step and its administrative consequence before selecting the full code.
accepted.sec: Ceded Districts - territories and treaty

accepted.s: Who served as the Principal Collector of the Ceded Districts?
accepted.x: Thomas Munro served as Principal Collector of the Ceded Districts.
accepted.tq: Match the administrator with the specific region rather than with the Hyderabad Residency.
accepted.sec: Ceded Districts - territories and treaty

accepted.s:
Under the Subsidiary Alliance, the British Resident at Hyderabad primarily:
1. Controlled the Nizam's foreign relations.
2. Supervised the subsidiary force.
3. Exercised direct hereditary succession to the Nizam's throne.
Select the correct answer using the code below.
accepted.x: The Resident controlled the Nizam's foreign relations and supervised the subsidiary force. The Resident did not possess hereditary succession to the Nizam's throne.
accepted.tq: Identify the actual functions of the British Resident and reject an extreme unrelated power.
accepted.sec: Hyderabad Residency and the British Resident

accepted.s: Which British Resident reported the presence of French battalions in the Nizam's forces during the 1790s and pressed him into the 1798 alliance?
accepted.x: Resident James Kirkpatrick reported the Nizam's French battalions in the 1790s and pushed him into the Subsidiary Alliance of 1798.
accepted.tq: Use the person–action association and distinguish the Resident from the military officer who repulsed the later attack.
accepted.sec: Hyderabad Residency and the British Resident

accepted.s: The Residency building constructed by James Kirkpatrick at Hyderabad was popularly known as:
accepted.x: James Kirkpatrick built the Hyderabad Residency building, which was popularly known as the Koti.
accepted.tq: Match the official building with its popular name rather than with other Hyderabad landmarks.
accepted.sec: Hyderabad Residency and the British Resident

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the attack on the Hyderabad Residency:
1. It took place on 17 July 1857.
2. Turrebaz Khan led the attack.
3. The objective was to free Chida Khan.
4. The attack was repulsed by Davidson.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Turrebaz Khan attacked the Residency on 17 July 1857 in an attempt to free Chida Khan, but Davidson repulsed the attack.
accepted.tq: Check the date, leader, objective and outcome together to identify the complete event description.
accepted.sec: Hyderabad Residency and the British Resident
